profile.name: along_arm
profile.source: 人为构造的比较实验。锚点、长度、外径、余量及角度预算均为假设，现场未测量。

scope.chord: Straight capsule between each pair of anchor centres; diameter is the outer diameter.
scope.length_envelope: Capsule radius = OD/2 + sqrt(L²-D²)/2 for L>=D. This encloses every centreline of arc length <= available length L at anchor separation D. Envelope overlap is a possible interference.
scope.length: available_length_mm is full free length between the two clips. Reserve is a required remaining allowance. Positive chord allowance is necessary; bends, clips and tension may use it up.
scope.link: Oriented bounding boxes of the STEP mesh's individual source solids. Only each span's endpoint links are omitted from its link check. A nonpositive gap flags enclosure overlap.
scope.environment: Explicit world-aligned nominal fixture and already-printed part boxes; samples only.
scope.angles: Mechanical multi-turn encoder-coordinate angles in the supplied DH zero. Travel sums sampled absolute increments. Straight-chord, length and joint-angle metrics do not measure actual hose twist.
unobserved: bend radius/contact forces, gravity and dynamics
attachments and sliding on attached links
